name: Farmer Hamon

intro.text: No cars, no problem. I haul the milk by tractor and the post by bike. Come on, then.

win: Aye, you've beaten me. Go on, then, wave.
after: In Sark the tractors are the buses, the ambulance, the fire engine and the milk float. We call the passenger trailer a toast rack. You'll see why when you ride it.
